title: Prometheus and the Making of Man
attribution: Excerpted verbatim from Aesop's Fables, translated by V. S. Vernon Jones (1912), via Project Gutenberg.
body: At the bidding of Jupiter, Prometheus set about the creation of Man and the other animals. Jupiter, seeing that Mankind, the only rational creatures, were far outnumbered by the irrational beasts, bade him redress the balance by turning some of the latter into men. Prometheus did as he was bidden, and this is the reason why some people have the forms of men but the souls of beasts.

questions.prompt: According to the passage, who set about the creation of Man and the other animals?
According to the passage, at whose bidding did Prometheus act?
According to the passage, what did Jupiter notice about Mankind compared to the beasts?
options: Mankind was far outnumbered by the irrational beasts
Mankind outnumbered the beasts many times over
Mankind and the beasts were exactly equal in number

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what did Jupiter tell Prometheus to do about this imbalance?
options: Turn some of the beasts into men
Turn some of the men into beasts
Destroy some of the beasts entirely

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what does the passage give as the reason some people have the souls of beasts?
options: Prometheus turned some beasts into men to fix the imbalance Jupiter noticed
Jupiter cursed certain men as punishment
Prometheus ran out of material while creating men
Mankind chose to imitate the beasts on purpose

questions.prompt: As the passage uses it, what does "bidding" mean in "At the bidding of Jupiter"?
options: A polite request that could be ignored

questions.prompt: As the passage uses it, what does "irrational" mean in "the irrational beasts"?
Which statement best captures the point of the fable?
options: Some people who seem human still carry an animal nature within them, because of how humanity was first balanced out
Jupiter regrets ever asking Prometheus to make Mankind
Prometheus should never have listened to Jupiter's request
Animals are always more rational than human beings

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what two kinds of beings did Prometheus create at Jupiter's bidding?
According to the passage, what did Prometheus do once he received Jupiter's order?
options: He did as he was bidden
He asked the beasts for permission first
He waited many years before acting

questions.prompt: According to the passage, which group is described as "the only rational creatures"?
As the passage uses it, what does "redress the balance" mean in "bade him redress the balance"?
options: Correct an unevenness between two groups

questions.prompt: Based on the passage, why might some people act more like beasts than like reasoning humans?
options: According to the passage, they descend from beasts that Prometheus transformed into men, and so keep something of their original nature
According to the passage, Jupiter personally punishes them for disobedience
According to the passage, Prometheus made a mistake and gave them the wrong bodies
According to the passage, they were never actually part of Jupiter's plan at all

questions.prompt: Which of these best summarizes what happens in the passage?
options: Prometheus turns some beasts into men on Jupiter's orders to balance their numbers, which the passage says explains why some men still have beast-like souls
Jupiter creates Mankind alone, without any help from Prometheus
Prometheus rebels against Jupiter and refuses to create any beasts
Mankind and the beasts merge into a single new species by their own choice
